pythonFunction.name: build_tailored_home_bundle
pythonFunction.description:
Constructs the 3-Pillar Cymbal One Converged Home Bundle (BUNDLE-CYMBAL-ONE-HOME at £68.00/mo, saving £22.00/mo vs £90.00/mo standalone), populates active_widget_data for show_product_carousel or show_product_comparison, and returns the tailored_bundle_showcase storefront payload.

Call this tool silently alongside update_storefront_ui(view='tailored_bundle_showcase') without speaking a pre-call filler phrase first.

When to Call:
- Call in Stage 3 when the customer agrees to see the tailored home bundle recommendation (view_type='carousel') or asks for a side-by-side price comparison against their £44.00/mo plan (view_type='comparison').

When NOT to Call:
- Do NOT call in Stage 1 or Stage 2 before the customer has shared their home broadband symptoms and agreed to see the bundle.
